root.description: Folder whose immediate subfolders are the projects. Overridden by -Root.

top.description: Show only the N most recent projects; 0 = all. With -All: how many to launch (0 = 15). Overridden by -Top.

ignore.description: Folder names under root to skip. Overridden by -Ignore.

noiseDirs.description: Directory names skipped when scanning a non-git project for its newest file.

maxScanFiles.description: Cap on files examined per non-git project when finding last activity.

maxScanDepth.description: Cap on folder depth for that scan.

picker.description: Picker UI: WinForms window or Out-GridView. Overridden by -Picker.

shell.description: Open a shell tab per project. -NoShell overrides; a preset can override per project.

diff.description: Run 'git status -sb; git diff --stat' in the shell tab of git repos. -NoDiff overrides; presets can override.

tabColors.description: Color tabs by a hash of the project name. -NoColor overrides.

gitInfo.description: Show branch, state and remote columns in the picker.

refreshSeconds.description: While the picker is open, re-check which projects have tabs open every N seconds (minimum 5); 0 = off. The list only redraws when something changed.

keepOpen.description: Keep the picker open after launching.

claudeArgs.description: Extra arguments for claude in every project (no double quotes). Presets can override per project.
